test_title: RRB NTPC CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 3 Mar 2021 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: What was 26th January called in India before 1947?
solution:
The correct answer is__** Independence Day**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Before 1947, January 26 was celebrated as **"Independence Day" or "Poorna Swaraj Day**" in India.
 
• This declaration was made during the** Lahore Session **of the Indian National Congress, held in December 1929.
 
• This date was chosen later to be the **Republic Day of India on January 26, 1950**.
 
• The **President of the Lahore Session **of the Indian National Congress in 1929 was **Pandit Jawaharlal Nehru**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Martyrs' Day or Shaheed Diwas** on **January 30** commemorates the assassination of Mahatma Gandhi in 1948.
 
• **Constitution Day (**India), also known as **Samvidhan Divas** or National Law Day, is celebrated on **26th November.**
 
• **Adoption Date: **On 26th November 1949, the Constituent Assembly of India adopted the Constitution of India.
 
• **Enforcement Date**: The Constitution came into effect on 26th January 1950, which is celebrated as Republic Day.
 
• **Drafting Committee**: The committee included esteemed members such as Alladi Krishnaswamy Iyer, K.M. Munshi, Muhammad Saadullah, B.L. Mitter, D.P. Khaitan, and N. Gopalaswami Ayyangar.
 
• **Dr. B.R. Ambedkar **was the chairman of the Drafting Committee established on 29th August 1947 to draft the Constitution.
